title: EPS bearer context modification accepted by the UE

entities.name: EPS bearer context modification accepted by the UE
entities.description: Procedure where UE processes MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message, stops timer T3396 under certain conditions, checks received TFT, and sends MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT message.

entities.name: MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by network to modify EPS bearer context parameters.

entities.name: MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by UE to accept EPS bearer context modification.

entities.name: Timer T3396
entities.description: Timer related to APN-specific procedures that UE stops upon receiving MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST under certain conditions.

entities.name: Traffic Flow Template
entities.description: Information element containing packet filters for mapping uplink traffic flows to radio bearers.

entities.name: Procedure Transaction Identity
entities.description: Identifier used to associate EPS bearer context modification with UE requested bearer resource procedures.

entities.name: Protocol Configuration Options
entities.description: Container IE that can include various parameters like APN rate control, WLAN offload indication, service-level-AA container, etc.

entities.name: Extended Protocol Configuration Options
entities.description: Extended container IE that can include additional parameters like service-level-AA container, ATSSS response, ECS configuration information.

entities.name: Service-level-AA container
entities.description: Container for service-level authentication and authorization parameters, including C2 authorization results and UAV IDs.

entities.name: Emergency PDN connection condition
entities.description: Condition where MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST is received for an emergency PDN connection, affecting T3396 timer behavior.

entities.name: UE stores rate control parameters
entities.description: UE behavior of storing and using various rate control parameters received in protocol configuration options.

entities.name: UE forwards to upper layers
entities.description: UE behavior of forwarding received parameters like service-level-AA container contents to upper layers.

relations.description: Procedure starts with receipt of MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message.
UE stops timer T3396 upon receiving MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST under certain conditions.
UE checks received TFT before taking it into use.
UE sends MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT message to MME.
MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message may contain PTI value.
MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message may contain Protocol Configuration Options IE.
MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message may contain Extended Protocol Configuration Options IE.
Extended Protocol Configuration Options IE may contain service-level-AA container.
If MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST is for emergency PDN connection, UE does not stop timer T3396.
UE stores and uses various rate control parameters received in protocol configuration options.
UE forwards service-level-AA container contents and other parameters to upper layers.
UE includes Extended Protocol Configuration Options IE in MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT message when forwarding service-level-AA payload.
